name: context-emendator
description: Workflow-config auditor for Claude and Codex agent context

interface.longDescription: Analyzes a repository's Claude/Codex agent context - CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules, skills, and hooks - for inconsistency, duplication, and token waste, grounded in official host documentation, and recommends human-approved corrections, retirements of bespoke mechanisms in favor of native ones, and gated enhancements.
